observations: Bruijns et al. Nature Neuroscience 2026 use explicit non-geometric state-duration distributions and explicitly identify allowing duration distributions to change over training as a desirable extension.

Farcomeni TEST 2026 provides a penalised HSMM that shrinks flexible sojourn distributions toward a parametric base kernel, especially geometric/HMM-like durations; this supports duration-evidence shrinkage as a generic robustness control, not a neuroscience-specific mechanism.
Godin & Thivierge PLOS Computational Biology 2026 still expose S1 Code as a ZIP, but the available public transport did not yield file-level source contents in this invocation.

design.filter: Age-expanded online semi-Markov filter over stable, temporary-silence, and persistent-change states. Temporary-silence and persistent-change have separate calibrated non-geometric duration distributions; duration-blind control uses one common geometric event-duration model.
design.calibration: Duration/emission/hazard and adaptive-weight hyperparameters selected on disjoint calibration seeds. Locked evaluation used 24 held-out seeds per regime, T=4000 steps, midpoint nonstationarity, cause-emission separation delta=0.3.
regimes: mixed duration swap + hazard shift + weaker cause-emission anchor

methods.capped_duration: state-specific duration log-Bayes factors clipped at 0.25 relative to geometric base before renormalisation
methods.unsupervised_association_trust: mixture of fixed HSMM and duration-blind filter; trust updates only from detected event duration and emission-derived soft cause identity, no true cause labels
methods.delayed_sparse_label_mix: comparison upper-bound receiving 50% true event-cause labels delayed by two events

design.task_integration: Posterior P(temporary-silence) gated dormant-memory anchoring in bounded PAST/GROUSE-like and Oja-like subspace-tracking regression simulations. Confidence threshold 0.99 selected on disjoint calibration events before held-out evaluation.

identifiability_sweep.principle: With equal cause priors and identical cause-emission distributions, swapping the labels attached to the two duration distributions leaves the unlabeled duration/observation mixture invariant. Therefore duration semantics cannot be recovered unsupervised from duration alone; a cause-identity anchor from emissions, prediction error, or feedback is required.

past_grouse_like.matched_temporary_silence: At locked 0.99 confidence gate, fixed-HSMM dormant memory reduced seed-level mean post-event MSE versus no memory by -0.00309, bootstrap 95% CI [-0.00542,-0.00072], n=8 seeds. Unsupervised-trust gating gave -0.00318 [-0.00498,-0.00149].
past_grouse_like.persistent_change_boundary: Under duration swap, fixed-duration posterior occasionally retained stale memory and increased post-switch error, but seed-level CI was wide; the unsupervised controller crossed the conservative gate zero times on tested persistent-change events, eliminating added memory interference in that bounded sample.

oja_like.matched_temporary_silence: Same dormant-memory mechanism did not show resolved benefit: fixed minus no-memory post-event MSE -0.00164, 95% CI [-0.02108,0.01425], n=8 seeds.
oja_like.interpretation: Slow Oja-like tracking already preserves inactive directions better in this bounded setup, so universal dormant-memory control is not justified; memory utility depends on tracker plasticity/time constant.

candidate_update.status: duration-aware latent-cause memory controller narrowed: explicit duration helps only while state-duration semantics remain anchored; abrupt semantic relabeling creates an identifiability barrier; shrinkage and tracker-specific high-confidence memory gating are safer than hard duration commitment.
candidate_update.positive_scope: Matched durations improve online cause inference and calibration. Non-geometric duration evidence is especially useful when cause emissions are moderately separable. A conservative posterior gate can convert high-confidence temporary-silence inference into small repeatable recovery gains for a fast PAST/GROUSE-like tracker.
candidate_update.negative_boundary: Fixed state-specific duration priors become severely anti-calibrated after duration-semantic swap. Unsupervised duration trust cannot fully recover if cause identity lacks an independent emission/prediction anchor; at exact emission symmetry the semantic swap is observationally label-permutation invariant. The same dormant-memory rule was not beneficial for the slower Oja-like tracker.

limits: All new numerical results are synthetic bounded causal controls, not a reproduction of SPLiT, Bruijns et al., or Farcomeni.

Unsupervised association-trust detector uses event boundaries inferred from the duration-blind filter and soft cause identity from emissions; it is not a generic solution to arbitrary nonstationary HSMMs.
Mixed regime deliberately combines duration-semantic reversal with weaker cause emissions and a stable/event hazard change.
PAST/GROUSE-like and Oja-like trackers are bounded source-inspired controls, not published SPLiT implementation; S1 Code remains unrecovered at file level.
Task-memory threshold and tracker gains were fixed on disjoint calibration events; task results use small seed counts and are mechanism probes.
bounded_audit.exact_next_action: Continue read-only SPLiT S1 Code.zip recovery without mutation. Replace fixed cause-labelled duration tables with an online state-identity-anchored duration learner: maintain separate duration experts only when emission/prediction prototypes supply enough cause identity, shrink each duration model toward a geometric base when identity confidence is low, and explicitly test label-permutation symmetry before trusting duration semantics. Compare against fixed HSMM, duration-blind HMM, capped/shrunk HSMM, and supervised oracle adaptation on held-out gradual duration drift, abrupt duration swap, class-prior shift, emission-prototype drift, and mixed nonstationarity. Feed posterior confidence into tracker-specific dormant-memory controllers with separately calibrated plasticity/time constants instead of a universal threshold; measure post-silence recovery, post-switch interference, Brier/ECE, duration-trust adaptation latency, false/true memory admission, and O(Nk) state cost. Preserve exact tested scope and a nonempty frontier.
